method.propertyInterpolation: piecewise linear; transition weights linear in elapsed blend time
method.sourcePhases: All integer frames of ordinary source clips; atEnd routes only frozen final frame; Resolve/Pick/Entry only neutral frame 0. Testing early ordinary phases conservatively includes phases a live in-progress blend may not expose. FeedbackDone uses Idle_Select and only leaves from its frozen frame1 neutral endpoint.
method.blendSourcePlayback: advance ordinary source, clamp one-shots and wrap loops; freeze atEnd source
method.zeroDuration: evaluate target at frame0 only; endpoint equality checked only against the reachable source endpoint/selector pose
method.geometryScope: All sphere-visible transition samples at source phases every4 frames, plus near-closed capsule/eye-group handoff phases; blend sample step .5 frames; original/target endpoints included. Geometry is checked in IdleFace local coordinates; root transforms are separately bounded.
method.handBounds: ExpressionHands radii60/58, original WritingHands radii60/58, with animated group/root transforms. Live hierarchy was confirmed by parent: Grip0-23 contains D120 HandNear0-36 and pen parts0-32/65/69; D116 HandFar0-40 is under WritingProps0-22.

contract.expandedArrayOrderCaveat: MCP expansion array order changed between snapshots. Conjunction order is immaterial; low-priority feedback may be coalesced/dropped at boundaries. High-priority modes and completion are protected by mutually exclusive guards. Native execution is the ordering authority.

resolvedFinding.problem: Unconditional restricted-state exit resets and Wake/Settle resets could erase fresh valid completion after target changed to mode0/2.
resolvedFinding.resolution: Only restricted-state entrances reset; celebration entrances/exits consume/merge. Wake/Settle and restricted-state exits have no reset.

hostContract: Accept actual completion only when current derived mode is 0 or 2.
Entering mode1/3/4 or hiding cancels pending feedback and rejects new feedback during that restriction.
FeedbackDone is celebration cleanup: Host merges/rejects new feedback while active or in cooldown; do not write a fresh true after its reset.
An accepted mode0/2 completion may be latched while an old visual state exits.
Cooldown and completion-source deduplication are Host responsibilities.
acknowledge/remind are low priority and may be dropped during transitions or outside idle.
Doze wake requires Host changing mode on activity; the existing Body pointer listener only fires acknowledge.
contract.scopeLimit: Live structure and reset constants independently verified. Native playback timing evidence is reported by the parent; native results override the instantaneous-action graph model. Final native rerun, rendered transitions and App/runtime/device remain separate.

nativePropagationFix.foundBy: Parent native simulateStateMachine; original 25 scenarios had 24 pass and ten_completions_merge entered Celebrate twice.
nativePropagationFix.cause: Native onExit reset had not propagated into the conditions read by same-frame Resolve; instantaneous-action static graph model could not expose this.
nativePropagationFix.resolution: Celebrate and CelebrateConcern finish through FeedbackDone using a required 16ms nonzero transition with earlyExit=false and source pause at 100% exit. This mixing boundary forces another advance before routing. FeedbackDone also has independent false onEnter reset and one-frame Idle_Select, with an end-gated outgoing transition requiring celebrateRequested == false before Resolve.
nativePropagationFix.nativeFollowupReportedByParent: One-frame zero-duration-entry version passed integer-aligned rates but native 7fps/24fps runs exposed early settling before reset propagation. After adding required 16ms nonzero incoming mixing, all 18 boundary runs at 7/10/24/30/60/120 fps with repeated requests 3/2/1 input frames before completion passed, celebrated once and reached Idle through 4 seconds. Final 25-case rerun remains separately reported by parent.
nativePropagationFix.modelBoundary: Constant-target graph check models FeedbackDone starting at entry with its cleanup action applied. A new true deliberately injected after cleanup entry violates the Host celebration/cooldown admission rule and could hold its false guard; no claim of a free-standing queue consumer.
nativePropagationFix.supersededConclusion: Earlier suggestion that the false guard plus one frame made 16ms unnecessary was disproved by non-divisor native frame rates. The final design requires 16ms incoming mixing; retain it.
